Channel: robinsongz - TFT | Date: 2026-03-07
Source: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CXuCH4nlsxY

This document summarizes actionable gameplay advice and meta analysis from the provided TFT guide video for Patch 16.6.

---

## Comp Recommendations

### Win Streak AP Opener (Noxus/Azir/Mel)
*   **Strategy:** Win streak with AP opener and econ, aiming for a fast 9.
*   **Early Game Board:** Play around Scion and Leblanc, adding Brier at level 5 and Kabuko at level 6. Can play 4 Invoker.
*   **Mid/Late Game Pivot:** At level 8, roll for vertical Noxus (Swain, Embessa for 5 Noxus). Alternatively, roll for 7 Noxus plus Kabuko, then pivot Embessa into Mel.
